title: Separating learning from search and feedback in budgeted inverse design of periodic unit cells
abstract: arXiv:2611.20480v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: To design a periodic material, engineers choose the shape and dimensions of a repeating cell to meet target properties. With few simulations, the benefit of a learned predictor can be hard to separate from the effect of which designs the search tries and how it uses simulator feedback. We compare two ways to predict properties in a library of 80 cell architectures, with up to 30 simulator calls per target. For each architecture, both searches use a table of predicted properties at different dimensions. One fills the table with predictions from neural networks. The other fits a simple model to the existing simulations for that architecture. Both searches use the difference between the predicted and simulated properties to adjust the next design. translated_title: 在周期性单胞的预算约束逆向设计中分离学习、搜索与反馈
translated_abstract: 为设计一种周期性材料，工程师需要选择重复单胞的形状和尺寸以满足目标性能。在仿真次数有限的情况下，学习到的预测器带来的收益很难与搜索尝试了哪些设计以及如何利用仿真器反馈所产生的影响区分开来。我们在包含80种单胞构型的库中比较了两种预测性能的方法，每个目标最多调用30次仿真器。对于每种构型，两种搜索都使用一个记录不同尺寸下预测性能的表格。一种方法用神经网络的预测来填充该表格；另一种方法则基于该构型已有的仿真数据拟合一个简单模型。两种搜索都利用预测性能与仿真性能之间的差异来调整下一个设计。在固定分析方案后，我们从仿真设计中生成了200个目标。结果显示，两种搜索在将三项性能均匹配至2%以内的频率上没有可检测到的差异（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究发现，在仿真预算有限的周期性单胞逆向设计中，使用神经网络预测器的搜索与对已有仿真数据拟合简单模型的搜索在匹配目标性能的成功率上没有可检测的差异。
en_tdlr: In budgeted inverse design of periodic unit cells, search guided by neural network predictors shows no detectable difference in success rate from search based on simple models fitted to existing simulations.
